newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $90 MLN CHINA GSM EXPANSION.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $90 MLN CHINA GSM EXPANSION.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Wednesday it signed an agreement worth $90 million with the telecommunications authority in Yunnan province in China for the expansion of a GSM network there.

"The value of the contract is approximately $90 million and continues the partnership between Nokia and Yunnan PTA which began in 1996. Deliveries will commence in September 1997," Nokia said in a statement.
Noka would supply mobile switching centres and base station subsystems as well as standard outdoor and mini base transceiver stations.

"This is the first time that this type of equipment has been delivered to a customer in China," Nokia said, adding the deliveries would give Yunnan PTA the capability to expand its GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) network to well over 500,000 subscribers.
